title: Ordinary ambient proper/open laws
statement: For every positive finite coefficient level, the canonical ordinary calculus satisfies all twelve Laws equations, including both geometric pasting directions and identities. No cartesian-square hypothesis is imposed. [def-sf-ambient-proper-open-calculus]

source.place: Tags 0F7B--0F7D; sites-modules.tex Tags 03D3 and 03EL; sites-cohomology.tex Tags 07A4 and 07A7.

proof.text: Use the proved source-library leftDerivedUpperStarComp_assoc_app and the two leftDerivedUpperStarComp_id_*_app equations, transporting equalities from Spaces to scheme maps. Package their iso forms as private PullCoherence. Apply generic conjugate and leftAdjointCompIso associativity and unit formulas to obtain all six pullback, pushforward and open-extension coherence laws.
Insert the two localized alpha-pasting equations and the two localized alpha identity-square equations. These are strictly the non-mate geometric parts of the argument.

Apply mateEquiv_hcomp to vertical alpha pasting and mateEquiv_vcomp to horizontal alpha pasting, using the two conjugate/whiskering compatibilities to retain exactly Calculus.sComp and Calculus.jComp. Apply the generic identity-mate calculations to the alpha identity equations. Assemble these four gamma equations with the six compositor laws and the two alpha-pasting equations into Laws.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0F7B--0F7D; derived.tex Tag 015F; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 07A7. Native pullback coherence, generic conjugation, and explicit mate-pasting calculations; T3.
